dialogues.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
dialogues.text: Ha! The clear speed was even faster this time! Nice!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Are you also participating in the Nilotpala Cup? How could you not know who I am...

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: An empty-headed outsider with a flying white mushroom... Pfft... You guys look so weak!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Wait, I don't think that's a mushroom... Ah well, makes no difference.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon, you're a shroom buddy now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's not the point! Argh, she is so cocky!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: What are you talking about? This is what you would call an intimidating aura!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I, Ajilenakh Dash, was the first to become an adult in the Ajilenakh Nut Gang! My lackeys all look up to me!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I work the fastest, earn money the fastest, read the fastest, and run the fastest. I'm faster than everyone else...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you eat Ajilenakh Nuts the fastest too?

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: That's right! Everyone tells me that I can eat Ajilenakh Nuts as fast as lightning! If there was an Ajilenakh Nut eating contest, I'd win it even after drinking a couple tanks of water!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Haha, what a straightforward nickname. But it looks like you're the one that's empty-headed!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: You! I've got my eyes on you, Flying White Mushroom! Just make sure you don't start bawling when I defeat you!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Then again, I might forget who you guys are by then. After all, there are so many people in the competition, and you guys hardly make an impression!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Just pray that you don't cross paths with me, Ajilenakh Dash, or you'll be beaten into the ground by my Fungi.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Arghh!!! We should've definitely used those two awesome nicknames!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: That's right! My Fungi and I have come up with a speedy strategy that can't be beaten!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: On my command, my Fungi will immediately swarm the opponent, and there's no way out of it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, isn't that the same as blindly charging at your opponent?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If there's a mismatch in overall strength, wouldn't you just lose immediately?

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Wh—What are you talking about!? Everyone's Fungi have relatively the same strength. It's obvious whoever's faster will win!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Stories of instantly defeating four opponents of the same skill level only exist in fairy tales!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Flying White Mushroom, I dare you to try next time if you don't believe me.

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: You're all just... extra practice for me before I become champion anyway!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There are quite a few contenders! Paimon wouldn't bet on us remembering who you are either!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, there's nothing to gain from beating you... Paimon really can't find any motivation...

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Heh! Assuming you can beat me, even though it's highly unlikely, I'd be willing to recognize your strength and treat you to some most delicious Candied Ajilenakh Nuts!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? The most delicious Candied Ajilenakh Nuts? Paimon wonders how they taste...

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Hmph, speak for yourself! Don't get yourself hurt!

dialogues.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
dialogues.text: What!? What's going on!? How could they have defeated all my Fungi in just the blink of an eye!? What am I gonna tell the others...

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Huh? What are you two doing here? Are you here to mock me!?

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Don't celebrate just yet! I'll win it all back next time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Next time? Paimon thought we only had one shot in the preliminaries?

choices.text: Maybe she meant the next season.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's a good thing. No need to take a single loss too hard!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, strange Ajilenakh Nut girl, Paimon is looking forward to our next fight!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Hmph, I'll be the one to comfort you guys next time!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: And if you guys aren't too mean about it, I might even consider sharing a few Candied Ajilenakh Nuts with you to make you feel better.

choices.text: She's still got some fight in her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Golden Comet and Silver Companion won!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Erm... The Fungi react to each other's skills. I may have been careless and forgotten about that.

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: It's dangerous to charge in without a plan. I'll keep that in mind from now on!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Whatever the case, my companions and I will make adjustments to our strategy and definitely beat you next time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm? You're speaking as if we're gonna go up against each other again...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The competition will probably have more than one season.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, that makes sense. Hopefully, she'll be as passionate as she is now in the next season.

choices.text: Don't feel too sad about it...

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I—I'm not sad! You just wait! I'll win it all back!

dialogues.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
dialogues.text: It's not fair! How come we only get one shot at this!?

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I'm talking about the competition! Why is it that I'm not allowed to continue after losing just one match!?

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I can still fight! Everyone's waiting to play with the Fungi that I should be bringing home!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You have to make it through the preliminary round to be able to continue... Didn't you know that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It feels like you signed up out of passion and didn't read the rules at all...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's very unfortunate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whatever the case, you already did your best and there's no point in looking back. It'd be better if you just relaxed with your Fungi.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't you have a bunch of underlings? Why don't you have them make friends with your Fungi and go on a picnic or an adventure...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Erm, never mind about the adventure part. It's too dangerous for them.

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Hey, you're right! I never got a chance to introduce the members to my Fungi!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Two of them even had the nerve to disguise themselves as competitors and try to steal the "most obedient Fungi foretold in the legends" or something... Good thing they didn't get in trouble for it!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: They could've just played with my Fungi!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why does that sound familiar...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, see? Isn't this better? There's no need to feel bad about it!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: But... I'm their boss... I'm the only one that qualified for the competition... I'm their only hope!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: In the past, we've always had to avoid the Fungi. We didn't dare get too close to them, even though some of them were really cute. Everyone was hoping that I would be able to tame a few as our gang mascots...

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: But I failed... It's all over now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then you should really hurry up, shouldn't you? You should let your members spend as much time as they can with your Fungi, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even though only the quarter-finalists are allowed to keep their Fungi after the competition, the competition isn't over yet. You still get to keep your orb and companions for a little longer!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Learn what you can from your loss and fulfill your promise in the next season!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Wait, you're right!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I never expected this White Flying Mushroom could be so smart! Thank...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're welcome.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're very welcome!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Erm... it still doesn't feel right to say it!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: You two! I'll let you off the hook this time! You just make sure you win the whole competition!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: That way, when I defeat you guys next time, I'll become the most popular competitor!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can't tell if she's trying to be funny or irritating...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh alright, you have a deal! Make sure you get stronger before we meet again in the arena!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: *sigh* ...I suppose feeling down isn't gonna solve anything. I need to pick myself up and get back to my members... I'll see you guys around!

dialogues.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
dialogues.text: My prize money... Why didn't I get any prize money!? I was so excited about it... I came here for nothing!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Yeah! I participated in the competition but didn't get a single Mora! That doesn't make any sense!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Erm... Paimon thinks the rules regarding the prize money are written on the billboard... Although the rules are a little complex and a hassle to read through, Paimon highly doubts there would be prize money for competitors that didn't make it past the preliminaries...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How about I share some of my prize money with you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Are you serious about that? We didn't get too much ourselves either, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Fine, Paimon guesses it's reasonable, seeing that we knocked her out before she knew what was going on...

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I... Umm... No, that's okay!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: It wouldn't be right to accept prize money given to me out of pity! My underlings will laugh at me if they found out!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, are you turning down Mora because of your pride as their boss?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's very reputable. Paimon is impressed!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, you should pay more attention in the future and at least read the rules before you do anything! Otherwise, you'll only get the short end of the stick!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I've already accepted it. I don't plan on making a scene! I just feel a little discouraged.

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Ahh, don't mind me, just leave me alone to sulk a little longer... I'll return to my normal self in no time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, she has always been loud and lively. She'll be fine.
